# Command Reference

This page is generated from NotQuests 6.2.0's native command tree.
It contains 1,315 executable command shapes.

Hover an argument or flag to see the description exported by the plugin. Required arguments use
`<argument>`; optional flags use `[--flag]` or `[--flag <value>]`.

:::tip
In game, tab-completion is still the best way to discover context-sensitive values like quest names,
tags, categories, players, worlds, materials, and custom items.
:::
